跨平台 TCP、UDP、HTTP 与 WebSocket

HttpNetworkRequest 支持异步 HTTP、进度、取消和自定义 IHttpDownloadHandler。设置 BypassCache = true 后，Web 使用 fetch cache: no-store，每次从网络读取且不写入浏览器 HTTP cache；适合直接读取 StreamingAssets。数据只在当前请求/使用期间保留在内存，不自动写入文件或 IndexedDB。

BEngine.Networking 提供领域请求、客户端状态、超时、内存准入、HTTP/1.1 解析和 BTask 工作流。原生 Socket/HTTP/WebSocket 与浏览器接口由 Platform 提供，包通过中立宿主能力适配。运行时异步操作接受 BCancellationToken，在所属线程取消并推进调度。TCP、UDP、WebSocket 暴露 Timeout/LastResult/Error/Exception，HTTP 暴露 Result/Error/ResponseCode/DownloadData/DownloadText。区分 TimedOut、Canceled、ConnectionError、ProtocolError 和 DataProcessingError，并始终释放客户端、请求和句柄。

using System.Net;
using System.Text;
using BEngine;
using BEngine.Networking;

using var stop = new BCancellationSource();

await using var tcp = new TcpNetworkClient { Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5) };
await tcp.ConnectAsync("127.0.0.1", 7000, stop.Token);
await tcp.SendAsync(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("ping"), stop.Token);
var buffer = new byte[1024];
var count = await tcp.ReceiveAsync(buffer, stop.Token);

await using var udp = new UdpNetworkClient(new IPEndPoint(IPAddress.Any, 0));
await udp.SendAsync(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("status"),
    new IPEndPoint(IPAddress.Loopback, 7001), stop.Token);
NetworkDatagram datagram = await udp.ReceiveAsync(stop.Token);

using var request = HttpNetworkRequest.Get("https://example.test/status");
request.SetRequestHeader("Accept", "application/json");
await request.SendAsync(stop.Token);

await using var socket = new WebSocketNetworkClient();
await socket.ConnectAsync(new Uri("wss://example.test/events"), stop.Token);
await socket.SendTextAsync("subscribe", stop.Token);
WebSocketMessage message = await socket.ReceiveAsync(256 * 1024, stop.Token);
await socket.CloseAsync(cancellationToken: stop.Token);

注入与扩展

HTTP 提供 Get/Delete/Post/Put 工厂；构造 HttpNetworkRequest(Uri, HttpRequestMethod, IHttpTransport?) 可注入领域传输。大响应使用 SendAsync(IHttpDownloadHandler, BCancellationToken) 流式消费，回调内的数据块按借用约定使用。WebSocket 可注入 IWebSocketTransport，默认 PlatformWebSocketTransport 委托宿主。平台可实现 IPlatformHttpTransport 或 IPlatformWebSocketTransport。默认宿主注册 AddBEngineDotNetPlatform；包初始化只注册领域适配器，旧 AddBEngineDotNetNetworking 已移除。
